# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v2 c4 P4](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v2 c4 P20](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0020), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a tall girl, standing a good two inches taller than most of her peers. She is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with golden hair.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c4 P16](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0016)_

## Personality

Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, possessing a soul full of mischief, pranks, and fun. She has a keen sense of humor and a thoughtful nature that appreciates beauty in literature, art, and life. While she works hard and conscientiously at her studies, she also loves going on walks and exploring nature with her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021), [v1 c37 P23](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0023), [v2 c6 P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 c13 P75](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0075)_

- To obtain a college degree from Redmond College  <sub>[v1 c34 P25](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0025), [v2 c9 P12](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0012)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Anne Shirley, Gilbert Blythe, and other friends from Prince Edward Island. During her time at Redmond, she lived at Patty's Place with Anne, Philippa Gordon, Stella Maynard, and Aunt Jamesina. Prior to entering Redmond, she taught school at Carmody for a time. At Redmond, Priscilla studied Classics, eventually graduating with Honors. Following her graduation, she travelled abroad to Japan, where she married a foreign missionary.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c36 P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008), [v1 c37 P29](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0029), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c9 P13](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0013), [v2 c16 P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
